title: The chunker splits a criteria table mid-row
area: RAG at scale: chunking and retrieval evals
scenario: Release 2026.11 shipped a new chunker and an embedding model upgrade together. The criteria agent now misses step-therapy rows and recall@5 fell from 0.98 to 0.67. The ML team wants to roll back the embedding model. Find the real cause and fix the chunker.
task: Reproduce with the BM25-only eval and inspect the chunks
Separate the two release changes with evidence
Rewrite the chunker to respect headings and table rows
acceptance: Every criteria row whole in exactly one chunk; header repeated
Correct section paths; nothing lost; recall@5 >= 0.95
Root cause and red herring backed by eval evidence

practices.label: Week 5 Mon - structure-aware chunking, parsing, metadata
